newsitem.title: USA: CBOT to distribute Project A profits to members.
newsitem.headline: CBOT to distribute Project A profits to members.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade directors voted Tuesday to distribute profits from the exchange's Project A electronic after-hours trading system to exchange members who are limited partners in the Ceres Trading Limited Partnership.
In early September, full CBOT members will receive an initial $1,000 each of profits from Project A. Those with other types of CBOT seats will receive smaller payments.
A CBOT spokesman said the exchange will revisit the income distribution issue annually. He said all but a "handful" of CBOT's 1,402 full members are limited partners.
The CBOT, which formed the Project A arm of Ceres Partnership in 1992, governs and is general partner of the venture. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
